## 2026-10-29 → 2.9.6 (English)

**Single-file distribution:** this release ships `SARibbon.h` and `SARibbon.cpp` as downloadable assets — add both files to your project to use SARibbon without building the library separately.

### New features

- **`SARibbonApplicationWidget` can now be used as an Office Backstage-style panel**, and `SARibbonMainWindow::setApplicationWidget()` binds it to the ribbon application button (clicking the button toggles the panel, no manual `connect` needed). New options:
  - `setWidthRatio()` — panel width as a ratio of the parent window, anchored to the left edge (default `1.0`, i.e. full coverage, so existing behavior is unchanged);
  - `setMaskWidgetEnabled()` / `setMaskColor()` — optional translucent mask over the rest of the main window; clicking the mask closes the panel, and Escape still closes it;
  - `setAnimationEnabled()` / `setAnimationDuration()` — slide-in from the left with a simultaneous mask fade (on by default, 250 ms, OutCubic easing).
- **System window buttons are now drawn in code** (`SARibbonSystemToolButton::paintEvent`) with a 1-logical-pixel pen instead of SVG assets: crisp at any DPI and visible on dark themes. New `glyphColor` property (`qproperty-glyphColor` in QSS); when invalid, the glyph color follows the ribbon theme. All 10 palettes gained a `titlebar-icon` token and the 6 QSS templates were updated.
- **Translations:** completed 49 missing English/Chinese strings covering ribbon customization and window buttons.

### Fixes

- **#160 — a new category page was not shown after all categories had been hidden.** `QTabBar` emits `currentChanged` inside `insertTab()` before the category pointer is written into `tabData`, so the handler returned early and the stacked widget stayed on the old page; because `currentIndex` had already changed, no later signal recovered the state. A new `syncCurrentCategory()` now runs on category insertion, visibility changes, context categories, `setCurrentIndex()` and `raiseCategory()`. Covered by regression tests.
- **Large buttons did not wrap their text at non-integer scaling factors (e.g. 225%).** After a font/DPI change the panel widget could keep the height of the old font while its layout was already arranged for the smaller visible rect. The wrap threshold read the widget height, assumed "one line fits", stretched the button and pushed it out of the visible ribbon area. The wrap decision now uses `min(widget height, actual layout height)`; font changes force a ribbon/category relayout, and the paint rect is recalculated before the first paint after a font/DPI/style change. New regression test `testWrapUsesLayoutHeightWhenWidgetIsTaller`.
- **`buttonMaximumAspectRatio` silently stopped working with some fonts.** The two-line height budget is now `max(single-line height × 2, lineSpacing × 2)`; with some fonts (e.g. Windows fallback fonts) the two-line `boundingRect` is close to two line spacings, so the old budget always reported "more than two lines" and buttons fell back to single-line full width.
- **Color tool button swatch fixed** (`SARibbonColorToolButton`): at a device pixel ratio ≥ 1.5 the color swatch disappeared and the enlarged icon covered it (device-pixel coordinates were applied on top of the pixmap's own DPR scaling). All geometry is now computed in logical pixels; the icon is bottom-aligned with the swatch directly below it (1 px gap, same width), and the swatch height scales with the icon (minimum 3 px, at most half the icon). The DPR is part of the cache key. This also fixes the swatch being clipped in 3-row mode and being barely visible in large-button mode.
- **Compilation fix for Qt 6.2–6.5:** `QEvent::DevicePixelRatioChange` exists only since Qt 6.6, but the guard checked 6.2. Thanks to @CokeStudios (#158).

### Build, CMake and CI

- **QWindowKit is now built in-tree by default.** With `SARIBBON_USE_FRAMELESS_LIB=ON` the top-level build prefers an installed package (`QWindowKit_DIR` or vcpkg), otherwise it adds the bundled `src/SARibbonBar/3rdparty/qwindowkit` as a subdirectory; a missing submodule is initialized automatically (`SARIBBON_QWK_AUTO_INIT_SUBMODULE=OFF` disables this). Output and install layout match the previous two-step build. The bundled QWindowKit was updated to the latest upstream revision (the commit preparing the 1.5.0 release).
- **QWindowKit runtime deployment** (`cmake/SARibbonQwkDeploy.cmake`): on Windows, `sarribbon_deploy_qwindowkit_runtime()` copies the QWindowKit runtime DLLs (Widgets/Core, plus qmsetup for shared builds) next to every example and test binary after linking. This fixes the "QWKWidgets.dll is missing" dialog when QWindowKit comes from an installed package, because Windows has no RPATH. Static and interface targets are skipped.
- **Qt builds without the Qt 3D module** now configure successfully; the Qt 3D examples are only built when the module is available.
- **macOS 26 SDK:** `AGL.framework` was removed, while Qt ≤ 6.8's `FindWrapOpenGL.cmake` still links it (`ld: framework 'AGL' not found`). When AGL is missing, CMake points `WrapOpenGL_AGL` at the SDK's `OpenGL.framework`; the workaround is inert on Qt 6.9+.
- **MSVC:** sources are compiled with `/utf-8`, avoiding C2001/C1057 for Chinese string literals on CI machines with a non-UTF-8 code page.
- **CI and docs:** added Dependabot for GitHub Actions and docs dependencies; upgraded all GitHub Actions; upgraded mkdocs-material to 9.8.0 (CVE-2026-73295) and pinned `mkdocs-with-pdf` / `pymdown-extensions`; the documentation site is now built (but not deployed) on pull requests against `master`.
- **Tests:** color-button assertions now use offscreen `grab()` rendering only, and `:hover` assertions are skipped on headless platforms — this fixes a Qt 5 headless crash (signal 11) when a QSS-styled window cleaned up focus while being destroyed. Added regression tests for category visibility and large-button wrapping.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/czyt1988/SARibbon/compare/v2.9.5...v2.9.6

## 2026-10-29 → 2.9.6 (中文)

**单文件使用**：本次发布附带 `SARibbon.h` 与 `SARibbon.cpp` 两个下载附件，直接加入工程即可使用 SARibbon，无需单独编译库。

### 新增功能

- **`SARibbonApplicationWidget` 应用窗口增强**，并新增 `SARibbonMainWindow::setApplicationWidget()` 把它绑定到 Ribbon 应用按钮（点击按钮自动切换显示/隐藏，无需再手写 `connect`）。新增选项：
  - `setWidthRatio()`：应用窗口宽度按父窗口比例显示并贴左边缘（默认 `1.0` 完全覆盖，保持既有行为不变）；
  - `setMaskWidgetEnabled()` / `setMaskColor()`：可选半透明遮罩盖住主窗口剩余区域，点击遮罩关闭应用窗口，Escape 关闭行为不变；
  - `setAnimationEnabled()` / `setAnimationDuration()`：显示时从左侧滑入、遮罩同步淡入（默认开启，250 毫秒，OutCubic 缓动）。
- **系统窗口按钮（最小化/最大化/关闭）图元改为代码绘制**（`SARibbonSystemToolButton::paintEvent`，1 逻辑像素线宽），不再依赖 SVG 资源：任意 DPI 下清晰，暗色主题下也可见。新增 `glyphColor` 属性（QSS 中为 `qproperty-glyphColor`），颜色无效时跟随 Ribbon 主题自动推导。10 个调色板新增 `titlebar-icon` token，6 个 QSS 模板同步更新。
- **翻译补全**：补齐 49 条中英文缺失翻译，覆盖功能区自定义与窗口按钮。

### 修复

- **#160：隐藏全部分类后新增/显示分类时页面不同步。** `QTabBar` 会在 `insertTab()` 内部同步发出 `currentChanged`，而分类指针要到 `insertTab()` 之后才写入 `tabData`，处理函数因此提前返回，stacked widget 停留在旧页面；此时 `currentIndex` 已等于目标索引，后续也不会再发信号。新增 `syncCurrentCategory()`，在插入分类、切换可见性、上下文分类、`setCurrentIndex()` 和 `raiseCategory()` 时补齐页面同步，并补充回归测试。
- **非整数缩放（如 225%）下大按钮文字不换行、按钮溢出可见区。** 字体/DPI 变化后 panel 控件可能保留旧字号对应的高度，而 panel 布局已按更小的可见矩形排布；换行阈值读取控件高度，判定“单行放得下”，把按钮拉宽并挤出 Ribbon 可见区。现在换行判断改用「控件高度与布局实际高度的较小值」，字体变化时强制 ribbon/category 重新布局，字体/DPI/样式变化后的首次绘制前重算绘制矩形。新增回归测试 `testWrapUsesLayoutHeightWhenWidgetIsTaller`。
- **部分字体下 `buttonMaximumAspectRatio` 静默失效。** 两行高度预算改为取「单行高度 × 2」与「lineSpacing × 2」的较大值。此前部分字体（如 Windows 回退字体）两行文字的 `boundingRect` 接近 2×lineSpacing，旧预算永远判定“超过两行”，按钮退化为单行全宽，宽高比上限不生效。
- **颜色按钮色块修复**（`SARibbonColorToolButton`）：设备像素比 ≥ 1.5 时色块消失、放大后的图标压住色块（按设备像素计算坐标，又叠加了 QPixmap 自身的 DPR 缩放）。现在全程使用逻辑像素计算；图标底部对齐，色块紧随其下（间隔 1 像素、与图标同宽），色块高度随图标等比缩放（最小 3 像素、不超过图标一半），缓存 key 包含 DPR。同时修复 3 行模式下色块被裁剪、大按钮模式下色块过小不明显的问题。
- **Qt 6.2–6.5 编译修复：** `QEvent::DevicePixelRatioChange` 自 Qt 6.6 才引入，原判断写成 6.2，导致 Qt 6.2–6.5 编译失败。感谢 @CokeStudios（#158）。

### 构建、CMake 与 CI

- **默认在源码树内构建 QWindowKit。** 开启 `SARIBBON_USE_FRAMELESS_LIB=ON` 后，顶层构建优先使用已安装的包（`QWindowKit_DIR` 或 vcpkg），否则把仓库内的 `src/SARibbonBar/3rdparty/qwindowkit` 作为子目录编译；子模块未初始化时自动执行 `git submodule update --init --recursive`（可用 `SARIBBON_QWK_AUTO_INIT_SUBMODULE=OFF` 关闭）。输出目录与 `cmake --install` 安装布局与原两步法一致。内置 QWindowKit 更新到上游最新版本（1.5.0 发布前的提交）。
- **QWindowKit 运行时部署**（`cmake/SARibbonQwkDeploy.cmake`）：Windows 下 `sarribbon_deploy_qwindowkit_runtime()` 在链接后把 QWindowKit 的运行时 DLL（Widgets/Core，动态库构建时还有 qmsetup）复制到示例与测试的可执行文件旁。使用已安装的 QWindowKit 包时，DLL 留在安装目录，而 Windows 没有 RPATH，从 Qt Creator 直接运行示例会提示缺少 `QWKWidgets.dll`，此改动修复该问题。静态库与接口库目标自动跳过。
- **没有 Qt 3D 模块的 Qt 也能编译：** Qt 3D 示例只在模块可用时构建，其余示例不受影响。
- **macOS 26 SDK：** 系统移除了 `AGL.framework`，而 Qt 6.8 及更早版本的 `FindWrapOpenGL.cmake` 仍会链接它（`ld: framework 'AGL' not found`）。SDK 缺少 AGL 时，CMake 把 `WrapOpenGL_AGL` 指向 SDK 内的 `OpenGL.framework`；该处理在 Qt 6.9+ 自动失效。
- **MSVC：** 源码统一使用 `/utf-8` 编译，避免英文代码页的 CI 机器上中文字面量触发 C2001/C1057。
- **CI 与文档：** 增加 GitHub Actions 与文档依赖的 Dependabot 自动升级；升级全部 GitHub Actions；mkdocs-material 升级到 9.8.0（修复 CVE-2026-73295），固定 `mkdocs-with-pdf` / `pymdown-extensions` 版本；文档站在针对 `master` 的 PR 上也会构建校验（不部署）。
- **测试：** 颜色按钮断言改为纯离屏 `grab()` 渲染，无头平台跳过 `:hover` 断言，修复 Qt5 无头环境下带 QSS 的窗口析构清理焦点时的崩溃（signal 11）；新增分类可见性与大按钮换行的回归测试。

**完整变更：** https://github.com/czyt1988/SARibbon/compare/v2.9.5...v2.9.6
